note.question: How do spiraling distortions and efficiency losses interact?
note.overview: Firms often finance their inventory through debt and subsequently sell it to generate profits and service the debt. Pricing of products is consequently driven by inventory and debt servicing considerations. The paper shows that limited liability under debt induces sellers to charge higher prices and to discount products at a slower pace.
